info.name: Game Studio Platform
info.description:
Requests for all four services (developer, team, game, sales) through the nginx gateway.

Start the stack with `docker compose up -d`, migrate and seed every service, then use '00 - End-to-end scenario' or the per-service folders. Each service folder is meant to run top to bottom; create requests save ids into collection variables with a short script.
